name: Picture develops
look: One large photograph develops once as it comes on screen. On a place, product or service page (look "film") it comes up out of the paper like a print in the developer tray: a faint grey print at first, its darks arriving before its light tones, then its colour, while it settles from a slight zoom, about 1.6 s. The halftone look ("print", a two-tone dot print in the page's ground and ink giving way to the photograph) is not dealt: tech leaves this moment out, so it is kept only as opts look "print".
phone: The film look runs on a phone too (one picture, a filter and a transform, once); the print look shows the photograph.

needs.picture: one photograph with a clear subject, half the container wide or more: the section's subject, not a thumbnail
